settings.title: Preferences
settings.max_cps.tooltip: Maximum automatic clicks per second. Too high may trigger anti-cheat. Recommended: 3~10.
settings.scan_interval.tooltip: How often to check the screen. Lower values react faster but use more CPU. Default 500ms.
settings.default_match_mode.tooltip: How to determine if text is 'found': contains / exact / fuzzy (tolerates small differences) / regex (advanced).
settings.close_behavior.tooltip: What happens when you click the X button: minimize to tray or quit entirely.
settings.show_close_confirm.tooltip: Ask 'Are you sure?' when clicking X to prevent accidental closes.
settings.auto_update.tooltip: Automatically check GitHub for new versions every time the program starts.
settings.notify_resource_warn.tooltip: Unchecking only stops the pop-up notification bubble; status-bar load indicators still show
settings.default_mouse_button.tooltip: Default mouse button for clicks. Left is suitable for most games.
settings.default_random_offset.tooltip: Randomize click position by a few pixels to avoid detection. Set 0 to disable.
settings.default_wait_ms.tooltip: Default milliseconds when adding a new Wait step.
settings.default_after_delay.tooltip: After-delay ms pre-filled when adding an action step (click/key/drag/scroll) or converting recorded rules. 0 = no wait.
settings.default_detect_after_delay.tool: Detect-delay ms pre-filled when adding a detection step (OCR / template match) or converting recorded rules. Waits after a successful detection for the game UI to be ready before the next step, avoiding empty clicks. 0 = no wait.
settings.default_fuzzy_threshold.tooltip: How strict text matching is. Higher values require closer matches. Default 0.8.
settings.default_template_threshold.tool: How strict image matching is. Higher values are stricter. Default 0.85.
settings.default_color_tolerance.tooltip: How much color difference is allowed during image matching. 0 = exact match.
combo.contains.tooltip: Match if text contains the keyword
combo.fuzzy.tooltip: Match similar text with adjustable tolerance for typos
combo.regex.tooltip: Use a custom pattern to match text with dynamic parts
settings.interaction_mode.tooltip:
How to send clicks and keyboard input.
Foreground is most stable and requires the window to be in front. Background (Frida inject) controls Unity-style games while you work on another window (no flicker), but carries an anti-cheat detection risk.
If the game does not respond to keys, it is a game limitation (some games only accept keyboard input while focused), not a tool issue.

Background injection failed. Try in order:
① Run the tool and the game as Administrator
② Make sure the game's main window is selected
③ Some games use anti-cheat / protection that blocks injection (use foreground mode for those games)
④ If you just restarted the game, injection must be rebuilt — run the click test again

Still failing? Switch to foreground mode in Settings to keep using the tool.

ocr_debug.key_test.key_choose.tooltip: Choose the key to send. Pick one that produces a clear, visible reaction on your current screen (e.g. a key that moves/confirms in a menu); note that Escape is often handled globally by games, so "Esc works" doesn't prove other keys work.
ocr_debug.key_test.tooltip:
Sends the selected test key.
Foreground mode: activates the target window first, then sends. Background mode: sends directly, then compares before/after screens.
Test on a static screen (a paused menu / non-animated spot): an animated screen changes on its own, so the comparison can't tell whether the key worked.
Note: Esc working doesn't mean other keys work (some games only handle Esc globally) — choose the key you actually use.
ocr_debug.key_test.ok: Background keyboard works: the target screen changed after {key}.
ocr_debug.key_test.no_change:
{key} was sent, but the target screen barely changed ({sim}% similar). This usually means the background keyboard input is blocked, or the game doesn't support background keys (e.g. it reads keys from real focus/foreground).
Suggestions: ① If you tested Esc, retest with a key you actually use (e.g. Enter/Space/1) — some games only handle Esc globally; ② Switch to "Foreground mode" in Settings and retest, to tell whether it's a background issue or a game issue; ③ If foreground works, background keys aren't supported by this game — use foreground mode.
ocr_debug.key_test.black:
Cannot verify keyboard: the recaptured image is black.

ocr_debug.key_test.window_changed: Window size changed; can't compare screenshots. Capture again before running the key test.
ocr_debug.key_test.short.no_change: Screen barely changed — keyboard may be blocked
